paragraphs.text: # 🍅 Pomodoro Pet (番茄精灵)
A focus companion for DSH Web / Desktop: a pomodoro timer, four-quadrant tasks, and a pet that grows
along with your focus.
**Version 0.10.0** · Requires DSH Web / Desktop `0.2.1-rc.2`+ · Zero npm dependencies · Data stays o
.0** · Requires DSH Web / Desktop `0.2.1-rc.2`+ · Zero npm dependencies · Data stays on your machine
**English** | 中文
## In one sentence
Open 🍅 in the DSH sidebar and start a focus round. When it ends, your pet gains EXP and the stats ar
e recorded. Sort work with four-quadrant tasks, and let the agent start timers or create tasks for y
ou — it always asks before changing anything.
After installing you get:

- A 🍅 **Pomodoro Pet** entry in the sidebar
- A draggable pet capsule in the bottom-right corner of

the chat page, with the remaining time always in view
- Focus, Stats, and Settings tabs; theme and l
anguage follow DSH automatically
## Features
### ⏱ Focus timer

- Three modes: **Standard 25 min / Deep 50 min / Sprint 15 min**
- Or set any custom length between

5 and 120 minutes
- Start, pause, resume, stop; focus rounds flow into automatic short and long brea

ks
- A round is restored from its deadline after a DSH restart, and missed settlements are reconcile

d
- Chime and desktop notifications, so you still hear about it when the tab is in the background
| Mode | Default length | Best for |

| Standard | 25 min | Daily tasks and routine work |
| Deep | 50 min | Coding, writing, anything tha

t needs immersion |
| Sprint | 15 min | Getting started, or clearing small items |
### ✅ Four-quadrant tasks
- Sort tasks into **A urgent & important / B important & not urgent / C urgent & not important / D o

ther**
- Estimate a task in pomodoros and bind focus rounds to it; EXP follows the task's quadrant
-

Drag tasks between quadrants, complete or reopen them, filter by quadrant
- Group related tasks tog

tasks between quadrants, complete or reopen them, filter by quadrant
- Group related tasks together
### 🐣 A pet that grows
- Every completed focus round grants EXP; evolve through **Sprout → Red fruit → Glowing fruit → Rain

bow king**
- Mood reacts to focus, breaks, abandonment, and level-ups; you can feed and greet it
- 1

8 achievements reward outfit fragments; 10 fragments redeem one of 4 outfits
- Resize the pet, drag
it anywhere, or tuck it into a compact capsule
*When you are busy, tuck the pet into the capsule at the bottom-right of the chat page: the countdow
n, pause, and stop controls stay within reach.*
### 📊 Stats you can actually use
- A focus heatmap for the last six months or the full year, so you can see how much you focused each

day
- Weekly focus time, time-of-day buckets (morning / afternoon / evening / late night), and quad

rant distribution
- Attribution by session and workspace, so you can see which project got your time

- Weekly and monthly reports, portrait and landscape share cards (PNG), and JSON backup
- Agent act
ivity: whether DSH is running, tools used today, and step counts
### 🤖 Focus together with the agent
The plugin exposes a `pomodoro_pet` tool to the agent:

- Start, pause, or stop the timer, or ask for the current focus status
- Read recent stats and list

tasks
- **Propose** new tasks or edits — nothing is written until you confirm in the UI
- Build a re
ad-only focus plan from the current session, tasks, and available skills
The pet is also a read-only status board for DSH sessions:
- When another session is waiting for your **approval** or **answer**, a flashing speech bubble pops
up above the pet capsule (the pet wags with a ❗ badge); there is also a panel chip, a "needs you" c

ard, and an optional desktop notification
- Click the bubble/chip/card/notification to jump straight

to that session
- This is observation only: the plugin never answers for you, never changes the age
nt's prompt, tools, or workflow, and never writes to a session
Just ask in a DSH conversation:

- "Start a 25-minute focus round"
- "Show me today's focus stats"
- "Add 'write weekly report' to qu
adrant B with an estimate of 2 pomodoros"
### 🔒 Data stays on your machine

- No uploads, no telemetry, no remote calls
- Session names, workspace paths, and task titles are sh

own locally only; task titles are hidden by default
- Agent context never appears in exported files
- Waiting alerts are observed locally from DSH session/approval events and only rendered in this bro

wser; they are never sent to the model and cannot change an agent's behaviour
- Data lives in `$DSH_
HOME/storages/pomodoro_pet/` (one JSON document per record); copy that folder to migrate. Upgrading
from 0.9.4 or earlier migrates the old single `pomodoro_pet.json` automatically on first start and k
er migrates the old single `pomodoro_pet.json` automatically on first start and keeps it as a backup
## Installation
Before you start: **DSH Web or DSH Desktop** (`0.2.1-rc.2` or newer). The plugin has zero npm depend
encies and needs no build step.
> Web and Desktop are separate profiles: Web uses `~/.dsh/profiles/web`, Desktop exclusively owns `~
/.dsh/profiles/desktop`. Installing on one does not make the plugin appear on the other; the focus d
ata (`$DSH_HOME/storages/pomodoro_pet/`) is shared.
### Option 1: Install from the Plugins page (Web and Desktop)
The plugin is published on npm as `dsh-pomodoro-pet`.
**Web**: open **Plugins → Installed → Add plugin**, enter `dsh-pomodoro-pet`, and click **Install**;
then restart `dsh web` and refresh the browser. This path is not delayed by the plugin-market index
